reasons: The claimed deviation is substantively correct: 'Fees' resolves to the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee and § 21.1 further narrows the basis to the first Order Form, so the mutual cap is illusory and there is no USD 1,000,000 floor.

The redline reaches the preferred position with a targeted edit to the single cap sentence: it replaces the defined-term basis with 'all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms' over the preceding twelve months and adds the USD 1,000,000 greater-of floor, while preserving the existing mutuality sentence and the Excluded Claims structure.
Correctly avoids reusing the compromised 'Fees' defined term, which would have left the cap illusory even after the edit.

Comment is accurate and on-tone: it explains the illusory-cap problem, states the playbook position, confirms indemnity/confidentiality/data-protection claims sit outside the cap via § 21.3, and offers a sensible fallback.
Deterministic checks all pass; the 0.362 changed-character ratio is justified because the rule requires replacing the cap basis and adding the floor.
